ratings_why.fun: Over a 7: one recruit-phase choice (who sits at the Source, who waits at B1, who stays downstream) runs the in-fight cascade, the Stamp economy and the Alevin triples together, and the same cards serve two opposed builds.
ratings_why.distinct: Over a 7: units physically climb the board mid-fight and a death pulls the whole run up and across rows, which no Battlegrounds tribe or generic auto-battler tribe does.

verdict_why: The engine is excellent, but Spawn's position and the Warden's many homecomings need wording that works as written.

points.text: Home happens at the Source in a fight, but Spawn happens next turn with the fish back in its recruit slot. Say that the Gift and the Alevin use that recruit slot, and that a fish still Spawns if it died after coming Home.
With Warden of the Hazel Well, say whether every fish that came Home Spawns next turn or only the first; the Home and Spawn keyword only names the first.
Mother Redd with Little Jack Gravel and the Warden sends several Alevins a turn to a hand of 4. Say where extras go; the nearest empty slot downstream would also refill the run.
Old Kelt is dead with a full board. He could instead swap with the unit at the mouth, which still opens the Source and keeps him useful on seven.
Brother Grilse is a plain tempo body. A tie to Stamps, such as gaining extra when he leaps past a unit with more Stamps, would give Tier 1 a combo seed in the 'mortified among veterans' joke.

standouts.why: The Bailiff does three jobs at once: a non-Leap dam at B1 for the Long Road, a Stamp source, and a sell-to-Spawn outlet that combos with Second-Run Hen and Jack.
Old Kelt turns an empty slot into a Stamp for every fish and a guaranteed homecoming before the first blow; a lovely off-label use of a gap.
Reunion Cock's exact-Stamp match is a real puzzle: the run stays in step on its own, and every Spawn, Smolt or Bailiff breaks or fixes the year-class.

weakest.why: Brother Grilse only grows when it leaps and touches nothing else in the tribe.
Falls-Leaper is a generic counter that rewards leaps without changing any decision.
Claw-Marked Cock is a solid body with a front-row bonus; it asks for no setup the cascade doesn't already give.

flags.note: Warden plus Mother Redd: about six homecomings a fight, each +1/+1 to all, then six Gifts next turn that never shrink their Stamps. Linear in Stamps, but very fast.
Whether every fish that came Home Spawns is not stated.
Alevin flood with Little Jack Gravel could give a golden Alevin and a Discover most turns; the designer already names it.
